messages:
Ava: Late-night kitchen check — I'm brewing a pot. Quick inventory: green tea x3, chamomile x2, open Earl Grey x1, milk ~1L, biscuits? Anyone got extras? :tea: :cookie:
Diego: I'll swing by with a tub of shortbread in 15.
Priya: Heads up — half-empty jar of that sugar substitute in the pantry. Can we please label things? Also, new compost bin is by the sink.
Sam: Microwave is clean btw. Please don't reheat foil-wrapped food. :eyes:
Tom: Can we put a post-it on the milk saying 'for coffee only'? My cereal was ruined last week :sweat_smile:
KitchenBot: Inventory snapshot: green_tea=3; chamomile=2; earl_grey_open=1; milk=0.9L; biscuits=2_boxes; compost_bin=present.
Ava: Thanks! Diego — can you leave one of the shortbread boxes on the shelf labelled 'communal'?
Diego: Yep. Tally format I used:
```
item: quantity
milk: 0.9L
biscuits: 2
shortbread: 1_box
```
Priya: Love the tally idea. Can we add a 'shelf-claim' tag so teams don't hoard snacks?
Sam: Polite reminder: please label personal food with initials. Lost a lunch last week :(
Jen: If anyone needs tea around midnight ping me — I'm out on an errand but can brew when I get back. :crescent_moon:
Ava: Ok, closing note — if you take the last of anything please update the tally or toss a note in #lunch-plans. Thanks y'all :heart:
